svg.aria-label: About me, as a chess opening. 1. e4: grew up playing chess. 2. Nf3: my first working program. 3. Bc4: scripts, web apps, then systems that reason. 4. O-O: AI Engineer at RIPT building multi-agent LLM systems behind 110+ production chatbots. 5. d3: researching UI-to-code agents with the University of Luxembourg. A mini chessboard plays the Italian Game alongside.
svg.title: About me: the opening
svg.text: Chess player. Then programmer. Now the pieces are agents.
